title: Events maintenance and optional Discord linking
summary: TheySix Events entered maintenance on November 18 to prepare for the next event. No reopening date was announced.
author: Mihai, Manager

body.text: Players can now join without linking Discord to Minecraft. Those who link their accounts can receive a special Discord role and additional chances to earn resources from minigames.
The announcement thread was opened for players to guess the next event.

title: Update the Java runtime used by Minecraft
summary: Oracle issued fixes for CVE-2026-114938, a high-severity vulnerability that can allow remote code execution on affected systems.
author: Mihai, Manager

body.text: If you installed Java 17, 21, 25 or 27 separately for Minecraft or a server, install your Java vendor’s patched release for that version. Check the runtime selected in your launcher profile or server startup command.

items: Windows and macOS: use the updater supplied with your Java distribution, or install the patched build from the same vendor.

Linux: update distribution-managed Java packages through your package manager. On Arch Linux use sudo pacman -Syu, on Ubuntu or Debian use sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade, and on Fedora use sudo dnf upgrade.

For a manual installation or version manager, update through the same source. Run the selected Java executable with -version, compare the build with your vendor’s advisory, then restart Minecraft or the server.

body.text: The official Minecraft Launcher manages its bundled runtime. If your profile specifies a custom Java executable, check that installation separately.
